title: Show how many pages the document has
objective: Show how many pages the document has on the document page, in the document's meta line (data-testid="doc-meta"), like "18 pages".
acceptance: The document page meta line reads "18 pages" for the 18-page Q3 Board Deck (d1)
A one-page document reads "1 page", not "1 pages"
The page count is in the doc-meta line, under the title
plan_summary: Render the page count from doc.pageCount in documentPage; a small plural helper in format.mjs.
